paragraphs.text:
What’s behind the door makes you gasp. Amet Keh, the Curator, 
stands there completely immobile. His skin appears glazed, his 
eyes and face fixed in an expression of terror. The word, “Petrified!” 
escapes from your mouth, and something tells you that his mind 
still lives inside his paralyzed body. “How horrible!” you add.
“Yes,” one of the men says. “Something somehow did that to 
him. Who or whatever it was, also took the Karpathos Device.” 
There is nothing to do. Go to any Cairo location on the Egypt 
Location Table.
(362, 408)
